Yes, you should qualify. Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase (or renewal) **and** haven't used any of the membership benefits. Since you joined yesterday and haven't used anything, you're well within that window.

Be careful not to use any benefits (free shipping, member pricing on pots and accessories, free change-of-mind returns, early access to rare drops) before cancelling, as that would make you ineligible for the refund.

The policy I have doesn't spell out where to cancel Leafy Plus, so if you can't find the option in your account, I can escalate this to a Support Lead. Refunds go to your original payment method, and once issued, cards take 5-10 business days and digital wallets 3-5 business days.
